### Google updates Gemini Privacy Hub to extend its retention period for temporary chats and chats with history turned off from 72 hours to around two months (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)
- URL: https://ainewsradar.xyz/news/54ecb7a012a52ca5
- Source: TechCrunch (https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/17/google-to-keep-gemini-chats-for-two-months-up-from-72-hours-even-with-history-off/)
- Executive Summary: Google updated its Gemini Apps Privacy Hub to extend the retention period for temporary chats from 72 hours to approximately two months. The company stated this change aims to improve system safety and incident response, explicitly noting that these conversations remain excluded from AI model training. Additionally, Google decoupled chat history retention from model training permissions, allowing users to maintain logs without contributing to model development.
- Key Verified Facts:
* [Core Event] Google (Gemini Apps Privacy Hub): Extended temporary chat retention to approx. two months and decoupled chat history from AI training settings.
* [Root Cause & Mechanism] To improve safety, system security, and troubleshooting capabilities while addressing user control over data usage.
* [Key Fact Detail] Google extended temporary chat retention to approximately two months.
* [Key Position & Outlook] Temporary conversations remain excluded from AI training data.

### Google’s Spark AI agent becomes ‘Tasks’ — and now it’s free
- URL: https://ainewsradar.xyz/news/2cededdf6305daa5
- Source: The Verge AI (https://www.theverge.com/tech/1035756/google-spark-ai-tasks-free)
- Executive Summary: Google rebranded its Spark AI agent to 'Tasks' and expanded its availability as a free service across the US, Canada, Japan, Korea, Australia, and India. Powered by the Gemini 4 Hydrogen model, the agent operates within hardware-isolated virtual machines to perform tasks such as calendar management and email analysis. For sensitive actions involving financial transactions, the agent is programmed to halt and require explicit user authorization.
- Key Verified Facts:
* [Core Event] Google (Gemini App interface): Launched Tasks agent powered by Gemini 4 Hydrogen, now free for selected regions.
* [Root Cause & Mechanism] To boost ecosystem stickiness by transitioning AI from passive chat to active task execution.
* [Key Technical Spec] Rebranded as Tasks and expanded to free users across multiple regions.
* [Key Position & Outlook] Mandatory user authorization for sensitive financial or high-stakes actions.
